'''Walter Gilman (Chapter 2)''' is a special [[ally]] used in [[The Strange Seduction]] of the 1st Arkham Spanish League.

==Card info==
*+1 [[Focus]]
*+1 [[Lore]]

If [[Yig]] awakens, the investigator that has '''Walter Gilman''' as an ally is [[devoured]].

==Notes==
This is one of multiple versions of the Walter Gilman ally used by different scenarios.
